title: Final Angle Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The relationship between particle velocity, index of refraction, and emission angle must be correctly derived.

title: Minimum Kinetic Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The minimum kinetic energy required for Čerenkov radiation must be accurately calculated.

title: Fractional Error Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The fractional error in the determination of the rest mass must be correctly derived and calculated.

title: Use of Relativistic Relations
description: Important Criteria: Correct application of relativistic energy and momentum relations in the calculations is necessary.

title: Understanding of Čerenkov Condition
description: Important Criteria: The condition for Čerenkov radiation (v > c/n) must be correctly identified and applied.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly in energy and momentum.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign errors in the derivation or calculation must be avoided.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any missing factors in the kinetic energy or fractional error calculations will lead to significant deductions.
